description: This file defines the 'Txn' interface and its implementation for handling transactions in the etcd client v3, including methods for conditional execution and commit logic.

classes.name: Txn
classes.description: Interface for mini-transactions with methods for conditional execution and commit.

classes.name: txn
classes.description: Implementation of the Txn interface, managing transaction state and execution.

methods.name: If
methods.description: Adds comparison conditions to the transaction.

methods.name: Then
methods.description: Specifies operations to execute if comparisons succeed.

methods.name: Else
methods.description: Specifies operations to execute if comparisons fail.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Attempts to commit the transaction and returns the response or error.
